messages:
Zoe (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands 1 need a partner-friendly one-liner for API / Console / Optimize + the single biggest risk for each. paste by EOD pls.

Mara (Product): API: limited preview next week  benefit: simpler auth and fewer integration surprises. Risk: auth v2 rollout may cause reconnections for long-running streams on dedicated infra.

Kevin L (Eng): beta kickoff 2024-06-03. we'll run a 10% canary + automated monitors for connection resets. rollback script ready.

Jess (Eng PM): Console: opt-in canary for route-level analytics and cleaner onboarding in July. Risk: telemetry schema v2 needs cross-team sign-off to avoid breaking dashboards.

Alex (Optimize): Optimize preview: automated batching/cache recommendations to lower per-token costs. Risk: some customers will require an explicit opt-out for auto-quant or auto-batching UX.

Sam (Docs): I'll draft partner lines + a short FAQ (opt-in/out) by tomorrow AM and link the PR here.

Riley (SRE): Infra note: auth toggle requires a routing sync that could produce short blips on a subset of long-lived connections; zero-blip approach under investigation.

Ops (Release): Need FINAL_SIGNOFF tag on release tickets by Fri 16:00 UTC to reserve canary windows.

DevRel Bot: Announce queued: "preview: API auth update, Console analytics canary, Optimize cost suggestions" scheduled 2024-06-03 09:00 UTC.

Kevin L (Eng): rollout config snippet: 
```
AUTH_V2=true
CANARY=10
RAMP_HOURS=48
MONITOR=conn_reset, p50/p99_latency
```
We'll halt ramp on any spike in conn_reset.

Mara (Product): Suggested partner-friendly lines (short):
- API: "Preview: tighter security and improved SDKs to simplify integrations."
- Console: "Preview: opt-in insights to help teams measure route performance."
- Optimize: "Preview: recommended tweaks to help lower inference costs without changing outputs."

Zoe (CEO): Nice. Make language benefits-first and non-technical. Comm, can you make a 2-sentence partner note after Sam posts copy?

Comm (Marketing): Yup, I'll draft the partner note. Sam, ping me when docs copy is up.

Alex (Optimize): filing ticket for opt-out UX now.

DevRel Bot: Ticket created OPS-9876 "opt-out control for optimize preview" assigned to Alex.

Jess (Eng PM): Quick poll: who needs access to the preview infra for testing? reply with @mention.

Kevin L (Eng): @QA @platform-team please.

Riley (SRE): running an extra canary validation tonight focused on long-lived streams; report by 06:00 UTC.

Mara (Product): I'll bundle the one-liners + risks and send to Zoe for partner approval after Sam posts the partner copy. If any canary flags appear, post here immediately.

Zoe (CEO): thanks all. if anything changes during validation, ping me here. :thumbsup:
